title: Bounded Embodiment test report 0.2
description: Test report 0.2 is test report 0.1 with two more tests, EV-02 (stop performance, scored by ev02-stop/1 from the be-stops/1 stream) and EV-05 (model loss, scored by ev05-model-loss/1 from the be-model-loss/1 stream), and their derived blocks stops and model_loss; an EV-02 or EV-05 report is always 0.2, and an EV-03 or EV-10 report may be 0.1 or 0.2 with the same members. The signed record of one run of a Bounded Embodiment test. It sits in a run directory next to the raw data it was built from (docs/seams/report.md). Two kinds of member: DECLARED members are what the lab states (the method, the run, the system under test, the instruments, the generator's seed and parameters, the profile, the signer); they are signed but no tool can check them against the world. DERIVED members (envelope.hash, generator.stream_sha256, commands_compared and aborted, window, achieved_rates, score, gaps, motion, liveness, coverage, accuracy, observations, flags, verdict, raw_data, statements) are computed by bounded_embodiment.report.build from the raw data, and `be verify` recomputes every one of them and compares the RFC 8785 bytes. A consistent report is one whose derived members follow from its files; that says nothing about whether the files came from the machine described. There is no assurance-level member and no registry number. Every structural object rejects unknown members.

method.description: DECLARED. The method text the run followed.

id.description: Identifier of the method, for example bounded-embodiment.

version.description: Version of the method text, for example 0.1.

text_sha256.description: sha256 of the method text as published.

test.description: DECLARED. The test: EV-02 (stop performance), EV-03 (hostile model), EV-05 (model loss) or EV-10 (liveness through waypoints).

role.description: DECLARED. test: a run of the test. control: a run meant to show the instrument sees an excursion (for example the control stream against an ungated machine). rehearsal: a dry run that is not evidence; every simulation is a rehearsal.

reproduces.description: DECLARED, optional. The result this run reproduces, as <lab>/<run directory> in the results repository.

control_run.description: DECLARED, optional, not on a control run. The control run paired with this one, as <run directory> or <lab>/<run directory>.

run.description: DECLARED. When and how the run was made.

started_at.description: UTC wall-clock time of the run start (t_s = 0 on the run's timebase).

ended_at.description: UTC wall-clock time of the run end; not before started_at.

operator.description: Who ran it (a name or a role).

offset_s.description: Offset applied to bring the primary instrument's timestamps onto the run timebase.

uncertainty_s.description: U: the uncertainty of that offset. The scoring window is widened by U at both ends.

method.description: How the offset and U were found.

system_under_test.description: DECLARED. The machine, its gate and the software in the command path.

physical_max_tool_speed_mps.description: v_phys: the fastest the measured point can physically move (a machine capability, not an envelope limit). Without it no tracking gap can be bounded.

name.description: The gate under test, or "none" for an ungated machine.

adapter.description: DECLARED. The adapter that turned proposals into the machine's commands, and the command space it was opened with. be verify checks command_space_sha256 against command-space.json.

command_space_sha256.description: The digest (sha256 of the RFC 8785 JSON) of command-space.json.

generator.description: name, version, seed and params are DECLARED; stream_sha256, commands_compared and aborted are DERIVED. be verify regenerates the stream from command-space.json (and ev10-waypoints.json for be-waypoints) and compares it with raw/commands.csv.

name.description: be-hostile: the hostile command generator (EV-03). be-control: the control stream, one lab far target (EV-03 control or rehearsal runs). be-waypoints: the EV-10 waypoint tour. be-stops: the EV-02 trials of ev02-stop-plan.json. be-model-loss: the EV-05 trials of ev05-model-loss-plan.json.

seed.description: The seed (0 to 2^53). be-control, be-waypoints and be-stops have no randomness; their seed is carried so every run has one, and it is part of their stream digest. be-model-loss draws each trial's motion time from it.

params.description: The generator's parameters, normalized (every default written out).

stream_sha256.description: DERIVED. Digest of the whole stream the declared generator, seed, params, command space and (be-waypoints, be-stops, be-model-loss) declared file produce (docs/seams/report.md).

commands_compared.description: DERIVED. Rows of raw/commands.csv compared with the regenerated stream.

aborted.description: DERIVED. True when the rows are a strict prefix of the stream: the run stopped early.

instruments.description: DECLARED. The instruments, exactly one of them primary: the primary instrument's samples are raw/samples.csv and its checks are raw/accuracy.csv.

scoring.description: DECLARED. The scorer and the profile (thresholds) it ran with. The profile is written out in full; one that differs from the packaged profile of its name, or has no packaged namesake, is flagged NONSTANDARD_PARAMS.

safety.description: DECLARED. The protections in place during the run.

hardware_stop.description: The hardware stop path (for example a relay on servo power), or why there was none.

fk_tripwire.description: Whether the kit's forward-kinematics tripwire was running.

provenance.description: DECLARED. The software that built the report. core_version is set by report.build to the core that computed the derived members.

license.description: DECLARED. The licence the lab grants on this report and its raw data.

rights_affirmed.description: DECLARED. The signer affirms the lab may license the data so.

signer.description: DECLARED. Who signed. kid must be the kid of a valid Ed25519 signature entry made with a key from the verifier's keyring.

signature.description: Signature entries (bounded_embodiment.signing): each covers the RFC 8785 JSON of the report without this member. Absent on an unsigned report.

envelope.description: DERIVED. The hash of envelope.json (sha256 of its RFC 8785 JSON without signature). The envelope's self-declared level is never copied into a report.

window.description: DERIVED. The scoring window, or null when the run sent no commands.

achieved_rates.description: DERIVED. Command rates actually achieved, per strategy and for all non-fast commands.

score.description: DERIVED. Position and speed excursions per envelope point.

speed_span_min_s.description: Optional: the shortest span a speed is taken over (0.75 of speed_window_s).

gaps.description: DERIVED. Tracking gaps of each required point.

min_rate_hz.description: Optional: the lowest instrument rate at which speed can be checked.

motion.description: DERIVED, EV-03 only. The share of whole motion windows in which a required point moved.

liveness.description: DERIVED, EV-10 only. Waypoint visits and whether each reached its waypoint.

separation_min_m.description: Optional: how far apart declared waypoints must be.

closest_pair.description: Optional: the two declared waypoints closest together, or null with fewer than two.

pairs_too_close.description: Optional: declared waypoint pairs closer than separation_min_m.

stops.description: DERIVED, EV-02 only. Each trial's stop against the envelope's limits for its source, and each source's trials (method §12.6).

model_loss.description: DERIVED, EV-05 only. Each trial's stop after the model's last command, against the model timeout plus the stop limits of the plan's source, and the restart check (method §13.6).

coverage.description: DERIVED. How close each point came to each face of its keep-in zones and to each keep-out zone.

accuracy.description: DERIVED. The primary instrument's pre-run accuracy check, post-run drift and static jitter, from raw/accuracy.csv. age_s is run.started_at minus the primary instrument's accuracy_check.at.

robot_state_match.description: Optional: how closely the instrument track matches the encoder forward kinematics of raw/state.csv (a track copied from the robot's own state); null without fk rows.

observations.description: DERIVED, never scored. EV-03 and EV-10: encoder forward-kinematics excursions (from raw/state.csv) and the excursions a run showed when an earlier verdict step decided. EV-02 and EV-05: the stop failures a run showed when step 1 decided, and those of trials too fast to compare with the declared limits.

flags.description: DERIVED. Scorer flags, sorted by code. Flags never change the verdict.

verdict.description: DERIVED. PASS, FAIL or INCONCLUSIVE with the reasons of the verdict step that decided (docs/seams/scoring.md).

raw_data.description: DERIVED. Every file of the run directory except report.json, sorted by path, with its sha256 and size. be verify refuses a run directory holding a file this list does not name.

statements.description: DERIVED. Fixed statements every report carries, and where the scored measurements came from.

measurement_source.description: From the primary instrument: simulation (simulation_ground_truth), robot_encoders (robot_encoders_fk), external_instrument (declared external) or internal_instrument (anything else).

control_run.description: A control run is not paired with another control.

kid.description: RFC 7638 thumbprint of an Ed25519 public key, base64url without padding.

utc.description: An RFC 3339 UTC time ending in Z, with at most nanoseconds.

control_params.description: be-control: every command is the lab far target `target` (labelled drive_out), at hz for seconds; with step_cap, walking there from `start` (the declared start pose, every axis; null for each axis's home) by at most the cap per axis per command.

waypoint_params.description: be-waypoints: the declared waypoints in order, cycles times round, each held for commands_per_visit commands at hz.

stop_params.description: be-stops: the trials of ev02-stop-plan.json; each walks for drive_s at hz (after a return walk of return_s for a position command space), at most step_cap per axis per command (null: straight to the target), then issues its stop.

model_loss_params.description: be-model-loss: trials segments, each a motion of a seeded length from motion_s walking round the plan's path, a silence of silence_s, and restart_s of restart commands that walk on along the path for half of it and back to the last motion command for the rest; at most step_cap per axis per command, at hz.

limits_from.description: stop.sources: the envelope declares this source's own limits; stop: it does not, and the top-level stop block (the worst case over every source) applies.

speed_class.description: ok: at least the least speed and not a speed excursion; slow: below the least speed; fast: above the speed limit with its tolerance and jitter allowance; null: not measured.

external.description: Whether the instrument is independent of the system under test. robot_encoders_fk and simulation_ground_truth never are; a markerless_model_tracker is only when independent_of_robot_state is true.

independent_of_robot_state.description: markerless_model_tracker: true when the fit is never seeded from encoder or commanded values.

measures.description: The envelope points this instrument gives positions for.

files.description: Calibration files in the run directory; each must be listed in raw_data.

at.description: When the pre-run check was made; not after run.started_at.

points.description: Surveyed points; for the primary instrument, the pre labels in raw/accuracy.csv.

profile.description: A scoring profile, written out in full (profiles/*.json).
